svg.text: if speech or singing is heard

g.text: text only; never hears the clip

text.tspan: The clip is cut into overlapping 3 s windows, one every 1.5 s. Each window is routed on its own.
For every chunk, a trained head on CLAP decides which of speech, music and environmental sound are

g.text: present. Here: speech and sound, no music.

text.tspan: Each open region is read by the encoder that fits it: WavLM-SV for gender, BEATs

g.text: and CLAP for sound. Only the small heads are trained.

text.tspan: The heads pick a path from region to attribute to value to leaf: speech > gender > female voice

g.text: (violet) and sound > animal > dog > Bark (amber). Music is not heard, so its branch stays grey; the small grey
circles are nodes the router did not reach.

text.tspan: Every reached node becomes one line of plain text.
Speech was heard, so Whisper's timestamped transcript is added. Without speech or singing it is left
Any frozen text LLM gets the context, the question and the options. It never hears the audio.
(b) a woman. The answer can be traced to the two nodes in the context.
